sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: base is an absolute URL string. href defaults to base and is resolved with the URL constructor.

sections.title: Returns
sections.body: A URL if its origin matches base, otherwise undefined.

sections.title: Usage
sections.body: Import this API from one of the entry points listed above. Keep server and build helpers in their dedicated subpaths.

sections.title: Behavior and edge cases
sections.body: This low-level core helper does not navigate or validate route registration. Invalid URL syntax can throw. Different protocols or ports produce a different origin and are rejected.
